name: The Black River
theme: Primeval Jungle, Ziggurats & Basilisk Cults (Cursed Scroll 4)
hazardTable: Swarm of army ants (DC 12 DEX or 2d6 piercing damage)
Toxic river leeches (DC 11 CON or drained 1d4 HP)
Falling canopy branch / deadfall (DC 12 DEX or 1d8 bludgeoning)
Poisonous vine scratch (DC 13 CON or paralyzed 1 round)
weatherTable: Torrents of warm deluge flooding low channels

factions.name: Itzalca Free Communities
factions.notes: Preserve tribal autonomy, fish the waterways, and drive off dangerous cultists.

factions.name: Priests of the Emerald Basilisk
factions.notes: Subjugate river communities, harvest venom, and awaken primeval serpent deities.

factions.name: Black River Guides
factions.notes: Charter canoe expeditions, trade exotic pelts, and scout unmapped inland tributaries.

uniqueFloraFauna: Rushing tributary spring filtered through volcanic basalt
River catfish, maize terraces, wild cassava, and sweet papayas
entryConditions: Expedition access point into The Black River.
